notes: Rooms show as tiles, three to a row (Settings switches back to the table), and every room has a detailed tooltip. The input delay is picked from the players' pings when a match starts (Advanced > Auto) and goes up by 1 after a laggy match. Once an FT series is decided the room stops; to play on, open a new room. Your room's header is tidier, the room chat uses the public chat's font size, MAME no longer opens a console window, and a room that disappears no longer leaves its preview behind.
